# The engine's bank-import-batch-v1 keyed route set (U-06, P25): a bank file import commit (its
# preview on the same route must carry no key) and undoing an import, `x-idempotency: true` in its
# openapi.json. Append-only for this capability name: `keyable-bank-import` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::BankImportV1`), keyed only while the engine advertises `bank-import-batch-v1`.
POST /api/v1/banking/feed/import-batch
DELETE /api/v1/banking/feed/import-batches/{id}
